reveal_en: Trillions of nearly massless neutrinos, born from distant stars, pass through your body every second. They are silent cosmic messengers, almost never interacting.
reveal_zh: 每秒，亿万无质量的中微子穿透你的身体，它们诞生于遥远星辰。这些寂静的宇宙信使，几乎从不互动。
meaning_en: You are a living conduit for an invisible river of the universe's most elusive matter. An intimate connection to the cosmos, beyond our senses.
meaning_zh: 你亦是宇宙最难以捉摸物质的活导体。这是与宇宙超越感官的亲密连接。

visual.color: Deep indigo, subtle shimmering silver, hints of faint aurora green.
visual.motion: Gentle, continuous stream of tiny, glowing motes silently passing through an indistinct silhouette.
